sentences.text:
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that similarly placed co-accused person,
Raghvendra Pratap Singh has already been enlarged on bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 30.10.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.43988 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.43988 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: There is no criminal antecedent of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 16.9.2023.

He further submitted that since the role of the applicant is identical to that of co-accused who has already been enlarged on bail, he is also entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.
5.
The prayer for bail has been vehemently opposed by learned A.G.A.
However, the aforesaid factual aspect of the parity to the co-accused has not been disputed by him.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the evidence on record, pending trial and in light of the judgement passed by this Court in Nanha S/o Nabhan Kha vs. State of U.P., 1993 Crl.L.J. 938 and the judgement passed by the Apex Court in Paras Ram Vishnoi vs. The Director, Central Bureau of Investigation,

entities.text: Nanha S/o Nabhan Kha vs. State of U.P., 1993 Crl.L.J. 938
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Paras Ram Vishnoi vs. The Director, Central Bureau of Investigation,
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: MANU /
, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed on the ground of parity.

7. Let the applicant- Bhartendu Pratap Singh, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with evidence.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the Trial Court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

9. It is made clear that observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.

Order Date :- 16.11.2023 Vikas [Krishan Pahal, J.]
